description: Browse 244 pixel art effects, tune them and export sprite sheets.
longDescription: A Pixel Effects panel with pixelfx's 244 code-drawn pixel art effects: fire, explosions, water, lightning, slashes, hits, pickups, transitions and whole attacks with an actor. Play one frame by frame, then change its backdrop, palette, seed, frame rate, length, size and its own options. Add a transparent sprite sheet or contact sheet to the Library, or save a sprite sheet with Aseprite JSON, a GIF or single frames to pixelfx/exports/ in the project.
example.1: Use the sprite sheet in pixelfx/exports/ for the player's hit effect.
example.2: Play the explosion sheet from pixelfx/exports/ when an enemy dies.
panel.title: Pixel Effects
